title: Diamond trellis egg, 1 dollar

specs.Decoration: digital printing, laser frosting, crystal insert

descriptionPlain: Description Dream of every collector Inspired by the jewelry work of art Delightful relief, rich ornamentation Symbol of prestige and luxury The dream of every collector – symbols of prestige and luxury, reaching dizzying prices at auctions. European kings dreamed of the products of the famous House of Fabergé. The best jewelry artists working there made royal insignia, jewelry and, above all, the legendary Easter eggs. A silver coin with a faithfully reproduced exclusive gift is sure to delight lovers of art and history.
